name: Eye Of Faith
introduce:
ROG-FE01 信仰之眼
著名硬件制造商ROG与卡玛达联合开发的重型机兵。在外形设计上采用了ROG系列一贯的前沿潮流风格，并配备了多处炫酷的发光光带。机兵内部则采用了来自卡玛达的成熟方案，业界领先的传动系统与岚合金框架，让信仰之眼在长线战斗中独占鳌头。

30378.name: Overcapacity Mod
30378.SpecificEffects:
When receiving repair effects, any overflow Repair AMT is converted into Temporary HP, up to <color=#F74848>24%</color>.
When attacked in battle, if possessing Temporary HP, triggers <buf ID=900023>[Quick Draw]</buf>.

20482.name: Fluid Generator
20482.SpecificEffects: When actively attacking or retaliating, restores HP to undestroyed parts equal to <color=#F74848>15%</color> of damage dealt after combat, and can repair <color=#F74848>1</color> destroyed part.
